'''Nudskutch''' was a settlement on [[Gamorr/Legends|Gamorr]].  During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], it and the surrounding region was controlled by the [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Rog]] and his wife, the [[Matron/Legends|Matron]] [[Gundruk]].<ref name="MS" />
